nodes.name: useChatProjection.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that projects raw session events into the optimized chat-item tree, offloading heavy sessions to a Web Worker (chatProjectionClient) while falling back to synchronous projection for small ones.

nodes.name: worker.ts
nodes.summary: Web Worker entry point that receives ChatProjectionRequest messages, delegates to ChatProjectionRuntime, and posts back ChatProjectionResponse or error messages.

nodes.name: ChatItemRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Slim dispatcher component that routes an OptimizedChatItem to the correct memoized renderer (user message, activity, read-file group, action summary group, stack group, or thread selector) based on item type.

nodes.name: ChatItemWrap.tsx
nodes.summary: Small presentational wrapper component that applies unified font-size, spacing, and width classes around chat item content.

nodes.name: ExtendedItemRenderers.tsx
nodes.summary: Collection of renderer functions for non-user chat item types (activity, read-file group, action-summary group, activity-stack group, thread selector, default), including stack-group label/status presentation logic.

nodes.name: GroupHeaderRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Memoized component rendering the sticky group/turn header above a chat item, with custom prop-equality comparators to minimize re-renders during virtualization.

nodes.name: GroupItemRenderer.tsx
nodes.summary: Largest per-item renderer in the chat history virtualization pipeline; renders a single group item (agent turn content, group chat bubbles, inbox transcript cards) with extensive custom memo comparators to control re-render cost across the virtualized list.

nodes.name: MemoizedItems.tsx
nodes.summary: Memoized wrapper components (MemoizedThreadSelector, MemoizedUserChatItem) that isolate thread-selection and user-message rendering from upstream re-renders.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the chat item renderer components and their prop types for consumption by ChatHistory.

nodes.name: turnMetadataAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Defines a Jotai atomFamily keyed by session+turn ID that holds per-turn metadata (e.g. duration, timing) so late-loading metadata doesn't invalidate the whole virtualized chat tree.

nodes.name: turnPageFormatting.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting helpers for the Cursor-IDE-style turn/round pagination UI: strips pill syntax from preview text and formats clock-time labels/ranges for a turn page.

nodes.name: turnTimingFormatting.ts
nodes.summary: Formats turn duration and clock-time labels used to display how long an agent turn took and when it started/ended.

nodes.name: ChatHistoryOverrideContext.ts
nodes.summary: React context letting a parent surface (e.g. subagent replay grid cell) inject a pre-computed event array that useChatHistory should return instead of the live session atom.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a collapsible group of grouped activity entries (tool usage summary block) with aggregated tool-usage counts and localized summary text for the action-summary chat item type.

nodes.name: AgentChatItemDefault.tsx
nodes.summary: Default agent chat bubble component handling streamed markdown/HTML content, expand/collapse of long responses, and theme-aware code block styling.

nodes.name: AgentErrorChatItem.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders an LLM/agent error as a single inline danger alert; deliberately avoids subscribing to the chat events atom to prevent a nested listener call-stack overflow.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a collapsible group of file-edit activity events with aggregated diff stats (additions/deletions) and tool-usage summary for the edit-activity chat item type.

nodes.name: useChatProjection
nodes.summary: Hook that decides synchronous vs worker-based projection based on event count, manages worker request lifecycle, and returns the current chat projection state.

nodes.name: ChatItemRenderer
nodes.summary: Memoized dispatcher component that switches on chat item type/source to delegate rendering to the appropriate specialized renderer.

nodes.name: ChatItemWrap
nodes.summary: Applies chat font-size, allow-select, and content-width wrapper classes around chat item children.

nodes.name: ActivityRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single activity row, resolving streaming state and suppressing a duplicate loading indicator for synthetic live activities.

nodes.name: renderActivity
nodes.summary: Renders an activity chat item, warning and returning null when the underlying event is missing.

nodes.name: renderReadFileGroup
nodes.summary: Renders a read-file-group chat item via the ReadFileGroup component.

nodes.name: renderActionSummaryGroup
nodes.summary: Renders an action-summary-group chat item via the ActionSummaryGroup component.

nodes.name: getStackGroupPresentation
nodes.summary: Derives the icon, label, and status text to display for a collapsed activity-stack group based on which activity kinds it contains.

nodes.name: renderActivityStackGroup
nodes.summary: Renders a collapsed stack of related activity events as a single summarized entry.

nodes.name: renderThreadSelector
nodes.summary: Renders a thread-selector chat item for choosing between parallel execution threads.

nodes.name: renderDefault
nodes.summary: Fallback renderer that logs a warning and returns null for unrecognized chat item types.

nodes.name: sameHeader
nodes.summary: Shallow-compares two group header value objects field by field.

nodes.name: sameMeta
nodes.summary: Shallow-compares two turn-metadata objects field by field for memoization.

nodes.name: sameGroupHeaderProps
nodes.summary: Custom React.memo comparator combining header and meta comparisons to decide whether GroupHeaderRenderer should re-render.

nodes.name: GroupHeaderRenderer
nodes.summary: Memoized component rendering the sticky group/turn header shown above a chat item group.

nodes.name: sameEventSummary
nodes.summary: Compares two event-summary records for equality across their tracked keys, used by chat item memoization.

nodes.name: sameChatItem
nodes.summary: Deep-compares two chat items' event summaries, event lists, and action-summary items for memoization.

nodes.name: areGroupItemRendererPropsEqual
nodes.summary: Custom React.memo comparator for GroupItemRenderer, short-circuiting on chat item and turn-related prop equality.

nodes.name: isWithinGroupChatContinuationWindow
nodes.summary: Determines whether two group-chat message timestamps fall within the continuation window used to merge consecutive bubbles.

nodes.name: InboxTranscriptCard
nodes.summary: Renders an inbox-transcript card summarizing a coordinator/agent-org message inside the group chat view.

nodes.name: GroupItemRenderer
nodes.summary: Central per-item renderer for the virtualized chat list, dispatching to agent turn content, group-chat bubbles, or inbox transcript cards while minimizing re-renders via extensive memoization.

nodes.name: MemoizedThreadSelector
nodes.summary: Memoized wrapper around ThreadSelector that reads selected-thread state from an atom and handles navigation to a thread's first event.

nodes.name: MemoizedUserChatItem
nodes.summary: Memoized wrapper around UserChatItem that strips pill content, skips rendering empty messages, and wires the edit-submit handler.

nodes.name: turnMetadataKey
nodes.summary: Builds a composite atom-family key from a session ID and turn ID.

nodes.name: getRoundPreviewText
nodes.summary: Strips pill syntax and collapses whitespace to produce a short preview string for a round's display text.

nodes.name: formatCursorIdeTurnPageTimeLabel
nodes.summary: Formats a start/end timestamp pair from a turn-page summary into a Cursor-IDE-style clock-range label.

nodes.name: formatTurnPageTimeLabel
nodes.summary: Formats the time label shown on a turn-page pill from one or more turn metadata entries.

nodes.name: formatClockTime
nodes.summary: Formats a millisecond timestamp as a localized clock time string.

nodes.name: formatTurnDuration
nodes.summary: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a compact human-readable string (seconds/minutes).

nodes.name: formatTurnClockTime
nodes.summary: Formats a millisecond timestamp as a localized clock time string for turn timing display.

nodes.name: getTurnTimingLabels
nodes.summary: Combines start/end clock labels and total duration into the label set shown for a turn's timing.

nodes.name: useChatHistoryOverride
nodes.summary: Reads the current ChatHistoryOverrideContext value, returning undefined when no override is active.

nodes.name: ActivityBlock
nodes.summary: Resolves and renders the lazy-loaded component registered for a given activity event's type.

nodes.name: suppressLoadingForNonLastRunningEvent
nodes.summary: Rewrites an event's status from running to a suppressed loading state when it is not the last item in the group, avoiding duplicate spinners.

nodes.name: buildGroupSummary
nodes.summary: Builds a localized summary sentence describing the counts of read/edit/terminal/tool events in an action-summary group.

nodes.name: aggregateToolUsage
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-tool usage counts across a list of action items into a summary structure.

nodes.name: ActionSummaryGroup
nodes.summary: Renders a collapsible card summarizing a group of mixed activity events with aggregated tool-usage badges.

nodes.name: AgentChatItemDefault
nodes.summary: Default agent message bubble handling streamed content detection, expand/collapse of long markdown responses, and theme-aware code block sizing.

nodes.name: AgentErrorChatItem
nodes.summary: Renders a sanitized agent/LLM error message inside a single inline danger alert.

nodes.name: countActivities
nodes.summary: Counts how many events of a given canonical tool kind (e.g. edit, create, delete) appear in an event list.

nodes.name: sumEditDiffStats
nodes.summary: Sums addition/deletion line counts across a list of edit-related events into aggregate diff stats.

nodes.name: ActivityBlock
nodes.summary: Resolves and renders the lazy-loaded component registered for a given edit activity event's type.

nodes.name: suppressLoadingForNonLastRunningEvent
nodes.summary: Rewrites an event's status from running to a suppressed loading state when it is not the last item in the group.

nodes.name: aggregateToolUsage
nodes.summary: Aggregates per-tool usage counts across a list of edit action items into a summary structure.

nodes.name: EditActivityGroup
nodes.summary: Renders a collapsible card summarizing a group of file-edit events with aggregated diff stats and tool-usage badges.
